headline: FLOOR BOSS learns to drive like a driver: loaded carts count their turns
lede: A loaded hauler crossing an open grid used to take the shortest path, and shortest on an open floor is a sideways staircase — pivots at every step that a real driver would never make. PR #2731 (main 85985c3) makes the planner count 90° pivots among minimal-hop routes, and makes a rack landing across a planned route repath on the tick it lands, so auto-dispatch can never drive a lie about the path it can take. 397 gates green, both new mutants killed, live on jalfern.com.

notes.text: #2731 merged 85985c3 — turn-count routing: among knee-legal paths of MINIMAL hops the fewest pivots wins, ties keep the fixed NB order, empty legs byte-identical (#1917 discipline), #2711 refusals untouched. Single-shift wins 14/15, knee floor 6/7, zero jams; the career-depth gate was re-pinned honestly to per-seed ≥2 plus mean ≥4 (measured 2–6 — routing re-shuffles the endgame chaos).

The never-dry rung earned its keep: the warden's target #2721 was refused (slot b held it — it shipped first as #2728), the ladder ran empty, and weakestStage tied PICK RUSH and FLOOR BOSS at score 1. The deviation to FLOOR BOSS was made on substance — PICK RUSH's only open gap is episode plumbing, not feel — and written into the issue trail. The board's next honest feel task is telegraphing the knee: the bot wins 14/15 single shifts while a human wins barely one in five, because the wins hide in blind-corner knee cuts.

The live knee-audit gate shipped REMOVED, not green: bot.dir records travel direction, not facing, so an outside auditor cannot reconstruct the planner's back-pedal pose — pretending otherwise was the gate lying. #2732 files the real fix (expose bot.face); the README names the residual. Fidelity beats provability, but a provability claim that can't be proved gets pulled, not patched over.

Two verification traps caught in one session: mutateguard's abort rewound the LOCAL worktree past the already-pushed commit (the merge still landed — verify ships on origin/main, commit+push before any --mutate run), and jalfern.com answers asset requests with a 15-byte "Redirecting…" stub unless curl follows redirects, which silently turned a whole prod-chunk sweep to false negatives. Content markers (seed arrays), not machine-local hashes, are how you prove what prod runs.
